purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign089, before opening any Campaign090 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures when scale-free intrabar price uncertainty is expressed across the completed session by the clock center of log high-low range mass. The mechanism is independent of transaction amount, close-return sign, return magnitude, one peak time, a fixed late window, or a morning-versus-afternoon binary split.
Choosing among clock moments would create an exposed parameter family around the selected first moment and would also closely mirror terminal amount-clock dispersion.
Selecting a cutoff or subwindow would search a timing threshold; the selected factor uses every one of the fixed 240 clock positions.
Multiplying terminal families would be a combination and would confound pure uncertainty timing with activity or return magnitude.
The binary half-session variance allocation mechanism is already terminal; changing its estimator or direction after exposure is not the selected mechanism.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_range_clock_center_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When a larger share of the completed session's scale-free intrabar price uncertainty is resolved later in the clock, price discovery remains active into the close and may continue from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For the exact 240 standard bars, set range mass r_i=log(high_i/low_i) and clock x_i=i/239 for i=0,...,239. Let R=sum_i r_i and return sum_i(x_i*r_i)/R.
selected_candidate.time_grid: Require the complete raw 241-row source identity, select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 in chronological order, and exclude 09:30. The clock continues monotonically from the morning positions to the afternoon positions but creates no price return across lunch.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected high and low must be finite and strictly positive with high greater than or equal to low. Exact zero-range bars remain valid zero masses.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 240 selected bars and finite strictly positive total log-range mass R. Use no epsilon, pseudocount, minimum positive-range count, threshold, dropped bar, or replacement.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 natural-log arithmetic and the exact rational clock coordinate i/239. Require a finite score in [0,1]; canonicalize only values within 1e-12 of zero or one.
selected_candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session 15:00 bar; no later session, daily return, comparison value, Candidate49 observation, or provider request is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
